sources.entry: Komodo | Build and deploy software across many servers

summary.one_liner: Komodo is a tool for building and deploying software across many servers, with a demo and docs linked from its README.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Komodo as a tool to build and deploy software across many servers. It states there is no limit to the number of servers you can connect and no limit to the API you can use for automation. It links to documentation, a live demo login, a build server login, a Discord community, a periphery setup page, and a roadmap. The README contains no installation commands and no feature list beyond these points. Light and dark theme screenshots are referenced but not shown in the text.
use_cases: automate server deployments through an API
manage a fleet of servers from one tool
how_to_run: See the docs (linked from the README) for setup instructions
Try the demo with the login provided in the README
Read the periphery setup guide linked from the README
notable: No limit on the number of connected servers, per the README
API-driven automation with no stated limit
Hosted demo and build server available to try
caveats: README includes a disclaimer that there are no warranties and use is at the user's own risk
Installation details are not in the README and must be found in the linked docs
Screenshots are referenced but not included in the text
